wants.topic: Hidden treasure mysteries at specific Indian sites (forts, caves, temples)
wants.evidence: Divya Katha's Tulsi Vivah (95.8x) is festival story but The India Story's Taragarh Fort mystery (91.29x) and Son Bhandar cave (10.41x) dominate; AG FACT's Tutankhamun treasure (107.96x) shows same pattern globally

wants.topic: Festival/ritual origin stories with 'why' and 'how' angles
wants.evidence: Divya Katha's Chhath Puja (27.85x) and Tulsi Vivah (95.8x); Unknown Itihaas's Diwali 100 years ago (3.5x) — all answer 'why celebrated' + 'how it changed'

wants.topic: Social history nostalgia: everyday life 50-100 years ago (weddings, festivals, customs)
wants.evidence: Unknown Itihaas's grandparents' era weddings (8.78x, 5.8M views) and Diwali 1926 (3.5x, 2.9M) — relatable, visualizable past

wants.topic: Origin mysteries: 'first king', 'where gold comes from', 'who built this'
wants.evidence: Unknown Itihaas's 'First king of India' (8.59x); AG FACT's 'Gold from dead stars' (13.64x) and gold history (7.25x) — secret knowledge reveals

wants.topic: Specific historical crimes/heists/betrayals with narrative tension
wants.evidence: The India Story's '1925 black night: raja looted own treasury' (19.18x) — crime + royalty + mystery combo

wants.topic: Mythological events retold as 'complete story in X minutes' with geographic/cosmic scale
wants.evidence: Divya Katha's Samudra Manthan (11.64x, 1.5M views in 57 days) — epic scale, condensed format

gaps: Forgotten regional kingdoms' treasure mysteries (non-Rajput, non-Mughal — Ahom, Chola naval, Vijayanagara hidden vaults, Bundelkhand forts)
Freedom struggle micro-mysteries: lost letters, disappeared revolutionaries, coded messages, Azad Hind gold
How specific festivals evolved in specific regions (not pan-India) — e.g., 'How Bihu changed in Assam 1900-1950'
Forgotten queens/warrior women with mystery angle (not just biography — 'where is her sword', 'lost tomb')
Ancient Indian scientific/technological mysteries with modern verification (not just 'ancient knew everything')
saturated: Standard empire overviews (Maurya, Mughal, Gupta, Roman, Byzantine) — Flashback Frenzy's Maurya (0.49x) and Byzantine (0.22x) prove fatigue
Major temple histories without mystery/treasure hook — Divya Katha's Lepakshi (0.17x) and Tarapith (0.13x)
Commodity histories (potato, sugar, shilajit, cotton) — AG FACT's potato (0.15x), Unknown Itihaas's sugar (0.01x)
Dark colonial violence/atrocities without investigative mystery — Unknown Itihaas's Timur (0.01x)
Speculative future/AI content on history channels — The India Story's bunker (0.24x) and robots (0.17x)
Generic 'complete history of X dynasty' long-form without specific hook
title_patterns: [Site Name] का रहस्य: क्या सच में यहाँ छिपा है खजाना? (Mystery + treasure question)
[Festival] क्यों मनाई जाती है? जानिए [Deity/Figure] की अद्भुत कथा (Why + amazing story)
[Number] साल पहले [Festival/Event] कैसे मनाई जाती थी? [Year] के भारत की अनसुनी कहानी! (Nostalgia + specific year + unheard)
[Person/Event] का संपूर्ण कथा मात्र [Minutes] मिनट में (Complete story + time promise)
[Object] धरती का नहीं है! [Shocking origin] | History of [Object] in Hindi (Counter-intuitive origin + science)
दादा-दादी के जमाने में ऐसी होती थी [Custom]! जब [Specific Detail] | Full Documentary (Relatable past + specific detail)
[Year] की वो काली रात: [Shocking Action]! 😱 | [Place] का रहस्य (Date + crime + shock emoji + mystery)
